name: Don't Fall In Lava
author: Addicting Games
description: Don't Fall In Lava is a free-avoider game. In this game, you'll find yourself ferrying a stick person across a treacherous landscape with lava forever below you, using your knowledge of physics to keep the stick person safe from harm. With every level, the challenges become more daunting, the obstacles become more perilous, and the rewards stay basically the same. In this game, you need to draw a line for the stick person to ride across, like a zipline. But beware - this is no simple task. With lava pits, spike traps, spinning saws, falling rocks, maybe lasers, and we’re guessing sharks in your way, you'll need to use your wits and your quick reflexes to keep your character alive. This mobile and desktop game is designed to be accessible to players of all skill levels. This is why the early levels are a little easier than the later ones. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a flavorless newcomer to the world of physics puzzles and stickmen, you'll find the challenges to be satisfying. “Don’t Fall In Lava” can be played on both mobile and desktop devices, so you can take the challenge with you wherever you go. Whether you're killing time on your commute, killing time at work, killing time at home, killing time in bed, killing time while watching a boring streaming show, or killing time while talking to a friend and or relative, this game is the perfect way to waste your time. It's time to embark on a thrilling adventure and show the world what you're made of. With simple gameplay, pulse-pounding puzzles, and the ability to play anywhere, this game is your new favorite.
